stimulus: single ON or single OFF event (n_events=1)
selection_rationale: Trial 48 of the SINGLE-EVENT voltage retune fit G_exc=G_inh=400 to Kim Fig 1C (SSE=58.26). On top of that the scientist chose a 1.5x INHIBITION BOOST for ON/OFF separation, so G_inh = 400 x 1.5 = 600 is baked in (G_exc unchanged at 400). E_Cl=-60: inhibition shunts the cross layer at small spots (stays ~rest) and hyperpolarizes it at large spots. The 1.5x boost pushes inhibitory conductance ~1.5x above the voltage-fit balance (still space-clamp-defensible).
note: PRIMARY config. model_dV_* above are the pre-boost values (G_inh=400); with the baked 1.5x inhibition the soma responses sit slightly more hyperpolarized and the ON/OFF layers separate. Scripts apply exc_scale=G_exc=400 and inh_scale=G_inh=600 automatically. To change the separation level, edit G_inh (= 400 x desired_boost) or re-run separation_tuning_sweep.
